class.name: Box3DParallelJoint
class.brief_description: A spring that keeps two bodies' axes parallel -- the self-righting joint.
class.description: Applies a torque that pulls [member body_b]'s copy of [b]this node's local Z axis[/b] toward [member body_a]'s. It constrains orientation only, never position. Point the node's Z up and leave [member body_b] empty to keep a body upright while it is still free to yaw and to move -- a character capsule that must not topple, a hovering drone, a camera boom. Soften it with the spring settings so it rights itself over time instead of snapping.

members.member: Torque budget for the spring, in newton-metres. [code]0[/code] means unlimited -- cap it if the body should be able to lose the fight.
Damping ratio of the aligning spring, non-dimensional. 1.0 settles without overshoot.

Stiffness of the aligning spring, in cycles per second. Higher snaps upright faster. [b]At 0 the joint applies no torque whatsoever[/b] -- this joint is nothing but its spring, so 0 hertz disables it rather than making it rigid.
